Messages.Author: Bearguys
Messages.Body:
Does anyone out ther know if this card has been issued. She is listed as a
Toreador Vampire. I was under the understanding that she was a book card
like Dan Murdock. When I contact Wite Wolf or WoTC they don't seem to
know.

Messages.Author: Robert Synnott
Messages.Body:
In a conversation with WOC today I was informed that the card was given
out on their recent Caravan Tour. White Wolf has no plans to publish a
book with this as a coupon card. I guess the only way to get one is to
trade or purchase for it from someone who was at a Carvan site and was
given one. If you find such a person(s) let me know as I would like to
purchase or trade for 1. My current offer is $15 for the card.

Bob
